scenarios.name: Hide and restore the panel of an active modeling command

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its solid block in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon displays the Modify panel
the user starts Shell from Modify
the Shell properties panel and model preview appear
the user opens the ribbon panel selector
the user clears Modify in the selector
the Modify panel disappears and the other ribbon panels reflow
the panel selector remains open
the Shell properties panel and preview remain visible
the user clicks a face of the block
the panel selector closes
the Shell face selection field still prompts for faces
the user clicks the same face again
the Shell properties panel reports one selected face
the model preview reflects the selected face
the user opens the ribbon panel selector
the user selects Modify in the selector
the Modify panel returns
the Shell properties panel still reports one selected face
the selected-face preview remains visible
the user cancels Shell
the Shell properties panel and preview close
the original solid block remains visible
